name: Sika® MultiSeal BT
tagline: HIGH TACK ELASTOMERIC BUTYL SEALING TAPE
summary: Sika® MultiSeal BT is a self-adhesive sealing tape based on a butyl rubber compound reinforced with an aluminium film. High tack butyl adhesive ensures reliable, durable long term bonding to a wide range of substrates in internal and external applications.
metaDescription: Sika® MultiSeal BT is a self-adhesive sealing tape based on a butyl rubber compound reinforced with an aluminium film. High tack butyl adhesive ensures reliable, durable long term bonding to a wide range of substrates in internal and external applications.
attributes: Good adhesion to many construction materials
Very good resistance to weathering and UV

usage: The Sika® MultiSeal BT is used for repairing, protecting and sealing:
Gutters and down pipes in metal and PVC
Ductwork for ventilation and air condition

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text:
The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C. Always refer to packaging.
Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

items.label: Bottom surface
items.text: Self adhesive butyl rubber compound protected with a release liner

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
The substrate must be sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, cement laitance, old sealants and poorly bonded coatings which could affect adhesion of the tape. The substrate must be of sufficient strength to cope with the stresses induced by the tape during movement.
For optimal adhesion, the following procedure is recommended.
NON-POROUS SUBSTRATES
Clean and pre-treat the substrate with Sika® Aktivator-205 applied with a clean towel. Allow a flash-off time > 10 min (max. 2 hours) before applying the tape.
POROUS SUBSTRATES
Use hot air to pre-heat concrete, aerated concrete and cementitious plasters, mortars and brick substrates to increase adhesion.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text:
Clean all tools and application equipment immediately after use with petroleum or turpentine. Once cured, hardened material can only be removed mechanically.
For cleaning skin use Sika® Cleaning Wipes-100 and wash with water and soap.
